tests.name: test_product_detail_quantity_decrease_edge
tests.title: Decreasing quantity below minimum leaves it unchanged

meta.dataFix: 2026-08-22: the plan asserted that add-to-cart disappears after adding, which is SauceDemo behaviour, not this site. Here the button stays and reads "Add to cart" unchanged; what changes is data-test="cart-quantity" appearing in the header, plus a toast. Neither exists on the page before the click, so a plan written from product_detail alone had nothing true left to assert about the click. Fixed by capturing product_detail_added and asserting the header count. Second correction: the test steps the quantity up to 2 before adding, so the header count is 2. My first fix made the assertion match the application and not the test's own earlier action - a consistent assertion has to agree with both.
